findings.description: OdontogramModule lacked contextDrawerTooth state, did not pass it to OdontogramViewContainer, and its floating tooth radial popup omitted the Tier 2 ToothContextDrawer action entirely, isolating the tooth detail drawer from the main clinical workflow. Additionally, OdontogramViewContainer memoization comparator omitted contextDrawerTooth, preventing re-renders on drawer open.
ToothContextDrawer backdrop applied heavy dimming and 4px blur across the whole viewport on desktop, completely blinding and occluding the left-hand dental arch while editing tooth details.
PerioToothCard utilized probingDepthClasses in standard mode where 5 mm was orange instead of clinical yellow (4-5 mm), deviating from the Florida Probe / AAP clinical mandate.

Clicking a probing site in PerioToothCard updated focusedSite but failed to auto-enable probe keyboard or transfer DOM focus to the chart container, causing rapid chairside numeric keypresses (1..9, 0..9) to be swallowed until the user manually clicked the container again.
TreatmentPlanWizard contained a black star dingbat (U+2605) inside the CBCT autoplan button alongside a Lucide icon, violating Mandate 8d (zero cartoon emojis and dingbats in medical UI).

TreatmentPlanWizard had unsafe undefined access on findings.implants and findings.boneDefects, undefined toothFdi assignment to toothNumber, and called non-existent static method SoundFeedbackService.playSuccess().
